profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, USA. It trades under the ticker NVDA and reported revenue of 215938000000 USD for the period ending 2026-01-25 in its 10-K filing. Its CIK is 0001045810.

Per its own site, NVIDIA offers the Nemotron family of multimodal, open AI models built for agentic reasoning, advanced math, and visual understanding. The company describes Nemotron as efficient and suited to long-running agents, with transparent training data and support across platforms including NVIDIA RTX PRO and NVIDIA DGX Spark. Related offerings named on the site include NVIDIA NIM microservices for inference deployment, NVIDIA NeMo for custom agentic AI, NVIDIA Blueprints for reference workflows, and tools such as NVIDIA Dynamo and TensorRT-LLM. Nemotron models are released under the NVIDIA Open Model License, a permissive license allowing commercial use and modification without crediting NVIDIA, and are also available as NIM microservices requiring an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license. The site names Bryan Catanzaro, VP of applied deep learning research, and mentions partner work with ServiceNow.

The site states that Nemotron models are built on top of frontier open models and that NVIDIA publishes model weights, training datasets, and training techniques. It also notes compatibility with open-source libraries including SGLang and vLLM.
